STI — Industrial Networking
STI-488XGGPM2B-2BT
8-port L2+ managed industrial PoE++ switch with hardware fiber bypass.
Key Differentiators
Fiber Bypass — Network continuity on power failure
Power failure or hardware fault triggers automatic optical bypass in ≤10ms — traffic flows directly between upstream and downstream devices as if the switch isn't there. Non-negotiable for power, transportation, and industrial automation where downtime has real operational cost.
PoE++ 90W + ERPS G.8032
Up to 90W per port (ports 1–2) for high-draw PDs. ERPS ring protection recovers in ≤20ms. Two independent redundancy layers on a single device.
10G SFP+ multi-rate uplinks
4× SFP+ ports support 1G / 2.5G / 10G auto-negotiation — uplink bandwidth scales to match aggregation layer without module changes.
